                            Project Details
                            About Ireo The Corridors

                            The Ireo The Corridors project in Sector 67A of Gurgaon offers a large residential township which is fully constructed and ready for occupancy has amazing luxury flats available from Rs. 2.20 Cr - 4.66 Cr. The gated community covers 37.5 acres and provides modern housing options together with extensive green areas and lifestyle amenities as well as essential services within a protected area. The Corridor exists as an independent residential hub which combines its spacious 2-BHK, 3-BHK, and 4-BHK apartments with landscaped gardens and sports facilities and educational and healthcare services and a shopping area that provides comfort and luxury living standards for all residents.

                            Ireo The Corridors: Key Facts

                            • The project name Ireo The Corridors is located in Sector 67A of Gurgaon.

                            • The developer of the project is IREO Management Pvt. Ltd.

                            • The residential township project has been completed, and its housing units are ready for new residents.

                            • The property covers a total land area of 37.5 acres.

                            • The building contains a total of 2 BHK and 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartment units.

                            • All construction work on the property has been completed, and all units are now ready for new residents.

                            • The building features several towers which collectively provide more than 1,300 residential units.

                            • The apartment was first launched to the public in November 2014.

                            Why to Buy Ireo The Corridors:

                            • The property exists in a prime residential area of Gurgaon's fast-developing district. 

                            • The ready-to-move status eliminates all waiting periods and status uncertainty. 

                            • The apartment unit offers spacious design with modern interior elements and multiple windows for natural daylighting.

                              About Developer
                              At Ireo, our stated goal is to become "The Big Multiplier" of our customers' quality of life expectations from their home. This commitment and our conviction that better designed living spaces lead to better lifestyles, are the genesis of Ireo’s philosophy of Open Living. Distilled from years of interaction and research with urban planners, home designers and customers, Open Living focuses on bringing an enhanced sense of openness and freedom to our customers’ lifestyles; through intelligent design and careful planning of multiple interlinked lifestyle needs. Not just within the four walls of one’s home, but also extending in to the surrounding Eco-system.

                              A testament to our commitment, our initial project launches - The Grand Arch, Ireo Uptown, Ireo Waterfront and Ireo Victory Valley are already making an indelible mark, and successfully challenging many of the existing paradigms of the Indian real estate sector. And this is just the beginning.

                              So come join us in crafting a world where both lifestyle and opportunity are not just redefined, but multiplied. That's the power of the Big Multiplier.
